en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 274 - Husain bin Ubaidullah has narrated from Abu Ja’far Muhammad bin Sufyan Bazufari from Ahmad bin Idris from Ali bin Muhammad Qutaibah from Fadhl bin Shazan Nishapuri from Hasan bin Mahbub from Ali bin Raab from Zurarah that he said:
There would be two occultations for Imam Qaim (a.s). We asked: What for? He replied: Because he fears for his life.
